facts.statement: This is an AI-based online cheating prevention system (proctoring solution) that monitors exam candidates through real-time video and audio analysis. The system uses YOLOv5 for object detection (detecting phones/books), MTCNN for face detection, and YAMNet for audio detection (speech/whispering). It enforces exam rules through system controls (fullscreen mode, shortcut blocking), tracks violations with timestamps, and logs violations to a logs/ directory for post-exam review. The system is designed for academic integrity enforcement in online examinations.

criteria.rationale: Repository inspection reveals no implementation of AI transparency features: (1) no user-facing disclosure of AI interaction in the main.py or module files; (2) no machine-readable technical markings on outputs; (3) no display labeling distinguishing AI-generated content. The violation alert system (alert_view) only shows warnings about detected violations, not AI system transparency information.

decision.rationale: This is an AI-based online cheating prevention system that uses AI models (YOLOv5, MTCNN, YAMNet) for monitoring exam candidates. The system processes biometric data (video, facial images, audio) in real-time and produces monitoring outputs. As an AI system deployed to end users (examinees and proctors), it falls under transparency and labeling requirements.

applicabilityBasis.rationale: The system is an AI system for academic proctoring, with clear use case purpose, deployment context (online exams), and involves AI-driven biometric monitoring which carries inherent risk.

criteria.rationale: Repository inspection reveals no implemented protective measures against intrusions, model poisoning, adversarial attacks, vulnerability exploitation, or data leakage. No safeguards ensuring confidentiality, integrity, or availability of the AI models, algorithms, or biometric data infrastructure. 1. Nhà cung cấp phải lập hồ sơ phân loại rủi ro đối với hệ thống trí tuệ nhân tạo có rủi ro cao và hệ thống trí tuệ nhân tạo có rủi ro trung bình trước khi đưa hệ thống vào sử dụng theo quy định tại khoản 1 Điều 10 của Luật Trí tuệ nhân tạo.
